text:
Maya: Heads-up: 'Benchmark Brief' mini-series launch. Plan: 4-email nurture tied to benchmark release + gated deck. Objective: drive downloads & webinar signups.

Noah: Suggest flow: Email 1 (announce + deck gate), Email 2 (highlights + CTA to register), Email 3 (case study snippet + demo CTA), Email 4 (last chance + highlight). Spread over 10 days.

Isha: Segment cohorts: product-trialers, engaged-docs readers, high-traffic accounts (top 500 by MRR). Personalized intro lines for top accounts.

Gina: Creative idea: include a small interactive snippet (GIF showing latency before/after). Keep file under 200KB for mobile.

Sam: Ops: stagger sends by account tier: top accounts send during business hours, others based on local windows. Rate limit 5k/hr global. Canary 2% with warmup.

Maya: Let's test subject lines: "Redwood Benchmark: what changed" vs "New benchmark + live webinar". Also test CTA text for higher-intent: "Request a demo" vs "Book a walkthrough".

Noah: I'll draft sequences + L2 personalization tokens for top accounts. Isha will review the account list to ensure accuracy.

Isha: Also recommending a suppression list for customers who've received a similar benchmark invite last quarter to avoid fatigue.

Gina: I'll produce 3 hero variants and a small GIF. Upload ETA Tue.

Sam: Ops config snippet:
```
campaign: benchmark-brief-v1
schedule: 2026-06-01 to 2026-06-11
throttle_global: 5000
tier_windows:
  - top-accounts: business-hours-local
  - default: local-10am-window
canary: 2
```
Pushing canary tomorrow AM.

deploy-bot: benchmark-brief-v1 created, canary scheduled 2026-06-01T10:00+00:00.

Maya: Great. We'll reconvene 24h post-canary to evaluate CTR & deliverability. If CTR < baseline -15%, hold ramp and iterate subject/preview.

Noah: Copy ETA Wed EOD.

Gina: Assets will be in drive and I'll place mobile previews in the thread.

Maya: Thanks team. Any other risks?
